title: Selected Topics in Computer Science; Algorithms for Geospatial Computing
description: Prerequisite: GEOG276 or minimum grade of C- in CMSC330 and CMSC351 or permission of instructor. Jointly offered with: GEOG470 and GEOG770. Credit only granted for: CMSC498Q, GEOG470, GEOG498I, GEOG770, or GEOG788I.
